name: Reporter
description: A special paint for {GAME_NAME} wiki editors.
interestingFacts: The creator of the paint is Summer (ex lmprove).
Until August 19, 2015, the paint had a different texture, which was based on notes from the newspaper. The author of the old paint texture is ACTPOHOM.
The paint used to be issued to Reporters. It was discontinued to be issued after the position closed mid-2021.
